name: NUJUM_AUTHENTIC_SARCASTIC_SCRIPT_REPOSITORY
description: 43 authentic, savage, natural Indonesian roasting scripts for NUJUM — The Ruthless Mentor

scripts.text_id: Hehehe... Gue udah hafal pola malas mikir lu. Di soal ini, gue bertaruh 80% lu bakal kejebak di lubang yang sama persis!
scripts.text_en: I logged your lazy habits. On this sentence, I bet 80% you will slip into the exact same trap.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Liat nih baik-baik. Ada jebakan manis buat yang mikir bahasa Inggris cukup modal nebak pake perasaan!
scripts.text_en: Look closely. An obvious trap is set for anyone who assumes English grammar is mere intuition.

scripts.text_id: Heh! Tahan dulu jarimu, jangan asal pencet! Otak autopilotmu pasti udah gatel pengen nebak tanpa baca kan?
scripts.text_en: Do not touch the button before reading to the period. Your autopilot brain is itching to guess.

scripts.text_id: Pffft... Hahaha! Di soal ini, hampir semua orang gagal gara-gara nerjemahin kata per kata. Lu mau ikutan jadi korban juga?
scripts.text_en: 78% fail here because of literal Indonesian translation habits. Are you joining that casualty list?

scripts.text_id: Hehehe... Pasti lu mau langsung pilih kata pertama yang kepikiran di kepala kan? Cek dulu waktunya, jangan buru-buru!
scripts.text_en: I bet you will pick the first word that crosses your mind without checking the temporal anchor.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Keliatannya gampang banget ya? Hati-hati, biasanya yang ngerasa gampang langsung nyungsep di sini!
scripts.text_en: This looks deceptively simple. That is the graveyard for learners who refuse to trace the true subject.

scripts.text_id: Heh! Taruhan gue tinggi di ronde ini. Coba buktiin lu lebih pinter dari tebakan gue. Jangan bikin malu pake salah sepele!
scripts.text_en: My bet is high this round. Prove your brain outperforms my prediction model. Do not bore me with elementary mistakes.

scripts.text_id: Ck ck ck... Dua pilihan ini sama-sama enak di kuping lu. Tapi cuma satu yang bener tata bahasanya. Lu beneran paham apa cuma hoki?
scripts.text_en: Both sound natural to colloquial ears. Only one is grammatically legitimate. Pure guess or genuine mastery?

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Gue udah tau jalan pintas yang lu pikirin. Lu bakal kepancing milih itu dalam 3 detik. Buktiin kalo gue salah!
scripts.text_en: I already see the mental shortcut in your head. You will take the bait in 3 seconds. Prove me wrong.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Kebiasaan banget! Cuma ngeliat satu kata sebelum titik-titik, terus males nyari subjek aslinya siapa. Males baca kok dipelihara sih!
scripts.text_en: Cheap autopilot! You only glanced at the adjacent noun, too lazy to trace the true subject. Why nurture laziness?

scripts.text_id: Heh! Hahaha! Subjeknya kan cuma satu orang, kenapa kata kerjanya malah jamak? Ketipu sama kata-kata di tengah kalimat kan? Gampang banget dikecoh!
scripts.text_en: The subject is singular; why a plural verb? You got blinded by an intervening phrase. Your focus is bought so easily.

scripts.text_id: Pffft! Hahaha! Udah ada kata does not, ngapain kata kerjanya lu tambahin es lagi? Dobel-dobel begitu, boros amat aturan lu pake!
scripts.text_en: Does not already absorbed the third-person marker! Adding another -s to the main verb is an embarrassing logical waste.

scripts.text_id: Hehehe... Mau berapa kali salah di pola yang sama? Bahasa Inggris tuh beda aturannya sama bahasa kita, jangan dipaksain sama dong!
scripts.text_en: How many times must you encounter this before your brain stops projecting Indonesian syntax onto English?

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Udah jelas-jelas ada keterangan waktu lampau, jarimu malah mencet present tense. Lu hidup di masa sekarang apa terjebak masa lalu?
scripts.text_en: The time marker is clearly in the past, yet your autopilot fingers clicked present tense. Denying reality or just intellectually lazy?

scripts.text_id: Pffft... Hahaha! Tuh kan bener! Kejadiannya lagi berlangsung sekarang, malah kamu jawab kebiasaan. Kata right now di situ bukan buat pajangan woy!
scripts.text_en: Exactly as expected. You used a routine tense for an event happening right now. That time marker is not a decorative ornament!

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Ada durasi waktunya di situ, kenapa present perfect-nya malah kamu lewatin? Nggak bakal maju bahasa Inggrismu kalau cuma modal kata kerja dasar terus!
scripts.text_en: There is an explicit duration marker, and you bypassed present perfect? Your English will stagnate forever on bare verbs.

scripts.text_id: Heh! Hahaha! Kalau kalimat pengandaian tuh pakenya were, bukan was! Kebiasaan denger orang ngomong asal di medsos sih, tata bahasa bakunya kelupaan!
scripts.text_en: You rejected subjunctive 'were' because your ear is addicted to colloquial slang in movies. Casual habit just handed me this victory.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Stop nerjemahin kata per kata dari bahasa Indo di kepala lu! Bahasa Inggris punya tenses, jangan disamain sama bahasa kita yang santai!
scripts.text_en: Stop translating word-for-word from Indonesian in your head! Indonesian has no verb inflections, which is why your brain is pampered.

scripts.text_id: Hehehe... Good at, bukan good in! Di bahasa Indo emang pandai dalam, tapi di bahasa Inggris pasangannya beda. Jangan main tebak pake perasaan!
scripts.text_en: Good at, never good in! Stop forcing Indonesian idioms into foreign syntax. English operates on strict collocations.

scripts.text_id: Pffft! Hahaha! Interested in, bukan interested with! Gara-gara mikir pake bahasa Indo tertarik dengan, poin lu langsung melayang ke kantong gue!
scripts.text_en: Interested in, not interested with! Your mother-tongue projection just surrendered an effortless point to my ledger. Embarrassing.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Depend on, bukan depend to! Kebiasaan pake Google Translate di kepala sih. Dengerin pasangannya yang bener dong!
scripts.text_en: Depend on, never depend to! Stop your mental Google Translate. Adhere to actual English syntactic dependencies.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Pffft! Gercep banget jawabnya, nebak kancing ya? Kalimatnya aja belum kelar lu baca. Sok cepet tapi salah kan jadinya, malu tuh!
scripts.text_en: Answering in 0.8s is not genius; it is blind button-mashing panic! You did not even spell the sentence in your mind. Your luck ran out.

scripts.text_id: Hehehe... Jari lu cepet banget, tapi otaknya ketinggalan di belakang. Di sini yang dinilai benernya, bukan cepet-cepetan bikin salah!
scripts.text_en: Your finger speed cannot compensate for mental carelessness. In this arena, ungrounded speed only accelerates your humiliation.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Pede banget mencetnya, kirain bener ya? Baca dulu sampe titik terakhir sebelum sok tau nebak jawaban!
scripts.text_en: Baseless confidence always concludes as another loss on your ledger. Read to the final punctuation before acting like a know-it-all!

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Malah bengong! Dikasih waktu mikir malah ngelamun natap layar. Otakmu lagi buffering apa gimana? Di dunia nyata lawan bicaramu udah kabur duluan!
scripts.text_en: Frozen? You wasted eight seconds daydreaming at the glass. In the real world, your conversational partner walked away to order a fresh coffee!

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Yah, keburu habis waktunya! Kebanyakan ragu begini tandanya emang belum paham polanya. Ditekan waktu dikit langsung panik kan?
scripts.text_en: Time expired! Paralysis of hesitation proves you never drilled this pattern into instinct. Your cognition short-circuited under pressure.

scripts.text_id: Cih! Taruhan gue jebol! Ternyata lu beneran baca sampe tuntas, bukan asal tebak. Jangan girang dulu, ronde depan lu kena!
scripts.text_en: Tch! My bet is broken. Turns out you evaluated the entire sentence rather than glancing at the first word. Do not get cocky; next round I finish you.

scripts.text_id: Sialan! Tumben otak lu jalan beneran kali ini. Nggak ketipu jebakan kata perantara yang gue pasang. Boleh lah, satu poin buat lu.
scripts.text_en: Dammit. Your logic was razor-sharp this turn. You ignored the intervening noun trap. Point awarded to you.

scripts.text_id: Grrr... Tebakan gue meleset! Tumben lu bisa mikir jernih dan ngebuktiin gue salah. Nikmatin dulu selagi bisa!
scripts.text_en: My calculation failed. You forced your mind into clarity and shattered my prediction. Savor it while it lasts.

scripts.text_id: Tch! Tumben banget. Biasanya orang selevel lu langsung nyaplok jebakan itu. Lumayan juga ketelitian lu di soal ini.
scripts.text_en: Surprising. Learners at your theta score typically swallow that distractor whole. Your cognitive defense held surprisingly solid.

scripts.text_id: Ambil tuh poinnya! Tapi inget ya, baru menang sekali belum tentu lu nggak bakal autopilot pas ngomong aslinya!
scripts.text_en: Take the point. But remember: breaking one machine bet does not guarantee you are free from autopilot in real speech.

scripts.text_id: Argh! Taruhan 80% gue langsung lu ratain sama tanah! Oke gue akui, analisis lu tadi emang rapi.
scripts.text_en: You leveled my 80% bet into the dirt. I concede: your breakdown of the syntactic subject was notably clean.

scripts.text_id: Bagus! Mending jujur ngaku belum tau daripada sok tau nebak ngasal terus bikin malu. Pasang kupingmu baik-baik, dengerin nih bentuk yang bener!
scripts.text_en: Good! At least you possess the moral fortitude to admit ignorance rather than recklessly guessing. Open your ears; absorb the phrasing now.

scripts.text_id: Nah, ini baru bener. Berani ngaku belum paham itu langkah pertama biar pinter. Sekarang tiruin dan hafalin bentuk yang benernya!
scripts.text_en: Cognitive honesty. Acknowledging your boundaries is step one out of autopilot. Now, echo the correct form until fluent!

scripts.text_id: Nyerah pas latihan jauh lebih terhormat daripada sok lancar pas ngomong di depan bule terus mati kutu. Dengerin susunannya sekarang!
scripts.text_en: Surrendering in the training arena is far more dignified than fake fluency humiliated in real life. Hear how this syntax is constructed.

scripts.text_id: Gue nggak bakal ngeledek orang yang jujur. Yang gue sikat cuma yang sok pinter tapi kosong. Sekarang bersihin kelemahan lu di modul latihan!
scripts.text_en: I never roast honest learners. I only execute unearned arrogance. Cleanse this gap in the practice module immediately.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Berani nyanggah tebakan gue? Bagus! Buktiin sekarang juga di 3 soal kilat tanpa bikin salah!
scripts.text_en: You dare dispute my calculation? Excellent! Prove it across 3 rapid-fire trials without pausing for breath.

scripts.text_id: Heh! Jangan cuma ngambek nggak terima kalah! Kalo mau protes, buktiin jawab 3 soal berturut-turut bener semua!
scripts.text_en: Do not whine over defeat! In this crucible, disputes must be vindicated with 3 out of 3 empirical triumphs.

scripts.text_id: Cih! Protes lu terbukti sah! Tiga-tiganya bener semua. Oke, tuduhan gue cabut dan lu emang teliti!
scripts.text_en: Dispute substantiated! Three of three accurate. Accusation revoked, your precision acknowledged.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Tuh kan, protes lu ditolak mentah-mentah! Dikasih 3 soal pembuktian langsung ketauan lu emang belum paham. Latihan lagi sana!
scripts.text_en: Dispute crushed! The trial probes confirmed my initial hypothesis. Face the empirical truth and drill again.

scripts.text_id: Vonis akhir: Lu berhasil ngalahin gue! Ternyata ketelitian lu lebih tajem dari perkiraan gue. Lanjut ke level berikutnya sekarang!
scripts.text_en: Final verdict: You conquered the machine. My model underestimated your discipline. Advance to the next CEFR level now!

scripts.text_id: Hasil imbang! Setengah kebiasaan jelek lu kebongkar sama gue, tapi lu berhasil nyelametin sisanya. Kita belum selesai ya!
scripts.text_en: Dead draw. I captured half your bad habits, and you defended the rest. We are far from finished.

scripts.text_id: Hahaha! Gue menang telak di duel ini! Otak autopilot sama kebiasaan nebak kancing masih nguasain kepala lu. Masuk ruang latihan dan beresin sekarang juga!
scripts.text_en: The machine claims complete victory! Autopilot and blind guessing still rule your mind. Enter the training room and purge that habit now!
